name: SafeBase
description: Let agents search your SafeBase knowledge base and Trust Center documents for approved answers, and, if you allow it, add new internal answers. For security questionnaires, RFPs and security reviews.
identity: A SafeBase API key, scoped to what the actions you tick need.

setup.title: Create an API key
setup.body: You need a SafeBase admin. SafeBase checks each call against the key's scopes, so give it only the scopes below. SafeBase shows the key once, so copy it for the form below.
click: Scroll down to the API Keys section and select Add API Key.
Type a name that identifies the agents in the Description box, such as AI agents.
Copy the key and keep it somewhere safe.

capabilities.label: Search answers and documents
capabilities.description: Search the knowledge base (answers from policies, past questionnaires, reports and the Trust Center), list and read Trust Center documents, and list products.
capabilities.note: Includes knowledge base entries marked private or internal, not only what the Trust Center shows publicly. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Add internal answers
capabilities.description: Add a question and answer to the knowledge base, visible only inside your company until someone in SafeBase changes it.
capabilities.note: New answers can be used in later questionnaire responses, so review what agents add.

limits.label: Products
limits.help: Optional: only answers and documents for these SafeBase products, by product id (shown under SafeBase products after connecting). Leave empty for every product.

revoke: In SafeBase, go to Settings, then API Keys, and suspend the key. Agents lose access to SafeBase at once.

tools.name: safebase_search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search the knowledge base for answers to a security question. Each result says where it comes from (policy, questionnaire, report, Trust Center or a manual entry) and who may see it.

query.description: What to search for, up to 512 characters

products.description: Only these product ids; leave out to search every product

tools.name: safebase_list_documents
tools.description: List Trust Center documents, such as reports, certificates and policies, optionally matching a search. Pass page 2, 3 and so on for more.

products.description: Only documents for these product ids
products.name: productIds

tools.name: safebase_get_document
tools.description: Read one document's details: name, type, file type, expiry date, tags and products.

tools.name: safebase_list_products
tools.description: List your SafeBase products, with their ids.

tools.name: safebase_add_answer
tools.description: Add a question and its answer to the knowledge base, visible inside your company only.

comment.description: A note for reviewers, such as where the answer comes from

access_level.description: Who may see the answer: internal (your company only)
access_level.name: accessLevel
